programs.title: Bad Chad Customs: Hot Rod From Heaven
programs.desc: The 10th annual Rockabilly Weekend car show is right around the corner, and Chad has big plans for this year's raffle car  the team races to transform a rusted-out '38 Ford into an open-motor, fenderless hot rod that's guaranteed to sell tickets.

programs.title: Downey's Dream Cars: Riv for Today
programs.desc: Robert Downey Jr. loves the design of his 1966 Buick Riviera, but it's one of the most fuel-inefficient cars ever made  he updates it with a one-of-a-kind rebuild.

programs.title: Car Fix
programs.desc: An in-depth look at electronic fuel injection  how to get an old carburetted engine to run more efficiently while keeping the same look.
